_how: Approve with: python -m speculum approve <chain id or bill, e.g. sjres32> (the reviewer is shown as "the editor" unless --by is given). The approval records a fingerprint of the chain's research; if the research changes, the approval lapses and the chain awaits review again. Revoke with --revoke.
